model_annotation: The image presents three donut charts illustrating the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four economic sectors in 2021. A legend at the bottom left identifies the four categories represented by distinct colors: "INDUSTRY" in gold, "CONSTRUCTION" in light blue, "TRADE" in red, and "OTHER SERVICES" in dark blue. Each of the three charts contains four slices corresponding to these categories, arranged clockwise in a consistent sequence starting from the top right. The first chart, titled "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows "OTHER SERVICES" (dark blue) as the largest segment at 61% (19.0 mln), followed by "TRADE" (red) at 19% (5.9 mln), "CONSTRUCTION" (light blue) at 12% (3.7 mln), and "INDUSTRY" (gold) at 8% (2.4 mln). The second chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," displays "OTHER SERVICES" (dark blue) at 51% (80.2 mln), "INDUSTRY" (gold) at 21% (33.0 mln), "TRADE" (red) at 19% (29.5 mln), and "CONSTRUCTION" (light blue) at 9% (13.4 mln). The third chart, "TURNOVER," indicates "INDUSTRY" (gold) at 33% (10.6 tln), "TRADE" (red) at 31% (9.9 tln), "OTHER SERVICES" (dark blue) at 31% (9.8 tln), and "CONSTRUCTION" (light blue) at 6% (1.9 tln). Both percentage and absolute value labels are positioned directly inside their respective slices in white text. None of the slices are visually emphasized through explosion, offsetting, or bolding.
